steps.en: The company data response from the government source is received
steps.id: Respons data company dari sumber pemerintah diterima
steps.why_en: The response is handled in code, but the job is off in the prod configuration.
steps.why_id: Respons diterima di code, tetapi jobnya mati di konfigurasi prod.

steps.en: Officer position data and IDs are received
steps.id: Data jabatan dan ID pengurus diterima
steps.why_en: Only ID, position code and dates are received; person name and address are missing.
steps.why_id: Hanya ID, kode jabatan, dan tanggal yang diterima; nama dan alamat orang tidak ada.

steps.en: The person in office at the offence date is selected
steps.id: Orang yang menjabat saat offence dipilih
steps.why_en: Nothing selects by offence date and term of office.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pemilihan berdasarkan tanggal offence dan masa jabatan.

steps.en: The selected person's data is saved
steps.why_en: Only shareholders are saved; officer data is deliberately not written to the database.
steps.why_id: Hanya pemegang saham yang disimpan; data pengurus sengaja tidak ditulis ke database.

steps.en: The system decides a 1st or 2nd reminder for that person
steps.id: Sistem memutuskan reminder ke-1 atau ke-2 untuk orang itu
steps.why_en: There is no decision; after saving, the notice is only marked as checked.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada keputusan; setelah data disimpan, notice hanya ditandai selesai dicek.
